bundle.build: npm run build: PASS (vue-tsc --noEmit && vite build)

environment: Chrome, locally built Vue client, Go API, isolated PostgreSQL schema, temporary attachment directory and two synthetic users. A local test proxy injected one HTTP 503; it did not proxy WebSocket. No production data or LiveKit was used.

checks.name: text_history_and_responsive_layout
checks.detail: TEXT opened with 50 of 60 seeded messages; Show previous loaded all 60 and displayed the beginning marker. At 1440, 1280, 1024, 768, 375 and 320 CSS px there was no document or message-row horizontal overflow, no action control outside its row, and the composer remained visible. Long author name, URL and attachment filename remained within the layout.

checks.name: text_edit_conflict_recovery
checks.detail: The server advanced a message from revision 1 to 2 while its editor held a draft. Save received HTTP 409, preserved the draft and offered Refresh version. Refresh displayed a review notice; a second Save persisted the draft at revision 3.

checks.name: text_retry_and_reply
checks.detail: One injected HTTP 503 showed a failed optimistic message and Retry send. Clicking Retry sent the message once; PostgreSQL TEXT count changed 60 to 61. A browser reply then showed its target preview and increased the count to 62.

checks.name: dm_history_mention_and_responsive_layout
checks.detail: DM opened with 50 of 56 seeded messages and loaded all 56 through Show previous. The long attachment filename and a resolved @qa_peer mention rendered. At 1440, 1024, 768, 375 and 320 CSS px there was no document or row horizontal overflow or control outside its row; the composer remained visible. Sending a DM with a selected mention increased the PostgreSQL DM count 56 to 57 and rendered the mention label. Opening the dialog removed its unread badge.

checks.name: dm_upload_browser_flow
checks.detail: Chrome's file chooser event timed out after both the file input and the visible Attach files button were clicked. The synthetic local file was never selected or uploaded.

checks.name: fixture_cleanup
checks.detail: The fixture reported CLEAN after dropping its isolated schema and attachment directory and stopping the Go API; ports 18082 and 18768 had no listeners. Temporary browser tab, viewport override, script, upload sample and Go binaries were removed.

remaining: Complete browser upload progress, success and error states in a browser with a working file chooser
Run full keyboard and screen-reader acceptance and verify real 125% and 150% browser zoom
Compare stored screenshots with design references across all workspace surfaces
Run voice/media/reconnect scenarios and repeat browser acceptance against a trusted release bundle
